description: Slack API unreachable during hourly content approval run. Both read.py and post.py fail with 'Tunnel connection failed: 403 Forbidden'. Cannot read thread replies from #content or notify David of approval/rejection actions. Workflow blocked.
correction: Restore Slack API network tunnel access. Verify bot token in config/.env. Check proxy/firewall rules blocking Slack Web API calls.
systemic_fix: Implement fallback notification via Ghost webhook or polling Ghost API instead of Slack thread reads; cache API responses to reduce tunnel dependencies.
